description: This Swift file defines a utility enum 'MicRefreshSupport' that provides functions for managing microphone refresh behaviors, observing audio device inputs, scheduling refresh tasks, retrieving microphone names, and binding voice wake state within the application.

methods.name: startObserver
methods.description: Starts observing an audio input device and triggers a refresh closure when an event occurs.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous refresh action with a delay, cancelling any existing scheduled task.

methods.name: selectedMicName
methods.description: Returns the name of a selected microphone device based on device ID.

methods.name: voiceWakeBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for the voice wake feature that updates the app state accordingly.
